environment.secondaryAdapter: AMD integrated GPU selected through radeon_icd.json
environment.gpuExecution: Serialized WebGPU/Vulkan hardware adapter; no software fallback

protocol.modelMetric: Geometric mean of three per-case median summed GPU kernel milliseconds; five requests per case after two warmups, unique inputs, automatic kernel selection
protocol.aggregateMetric: Geometric mean across four model families
protocol.pairedMetric: Interleaved old/new shaders from separate WASM builds; seven samples per variant and identical inputs
limitations: GPU kernel time is not browser round-trip latency.
Short-input load-time tuning and GPU clocks cause visible run variation.
Large CPU matrix checks sample 49 coordinates; old/new comparisons cover every output element.
No full-model performance claim for the secondary AMD adapter.
Rejected experiments ran kernel guards but did not all run full-model golden checks.
